messages:
marta: RFC: config-change approval + explainable audit traces for runtime flags (routing/quota)

marta: Proposal sketch — we need a single, auditable artifact for every config change that contains:
- human-readable summary: "what changed and why"
- machine diff (old -> new)
- rollout plan (cohorts, percent, start/end, phasing)
- approvers + approvals timestamps
- linked evals/metrics (pre/post expectations)
- immutable signature (who signed, KMS key id)

marta: Qs: store full snapshot for each change or only diffs + occasional snapshot? Store in console DB (fast reads) or append-only eventstore + archive to object storage? how to show "why" in the console UI without cluttering?

ben: For compliance I'd prefer snapshot + delta. Snapshots are cheap if compressed, and it makes audits easier.
ben: pattern: store snapshot in blob store, keep compact delta in DB for quick rendering. sign the snapshot via KMS and write signature to event store.
ben: sample audit entry (pseudo):
```
{ "change_id":"chg-1716123456-42", "actor":"ben", "approvals":[{"who":"marta","ts":1716123460}], "diff":"{...}", "snapshot_path":"s3://redwood-audits/chg-1716123456-42.json", "kms_sig":"projects/redwood/keys/runtimes/1" }
```

aisha: UX notes: console should show a 1-line "why" + expand for full rationale + expected SLO impact (latency/cost/quality). Add a clear Revert button that triggers an automated rollback playbook with a safety-check modal.
aisha: Also add a small inline "impact preview" that runs the dry-run evaluator on the current routing simulator and shows delta on key metrics.

sam: Approval flow thoughts:
- low risk: owner approval auto-apply
- medium: 1 reviewer
- high: 2 reviewers + infra SLA quorum
- add "timeboxed approval" where changes auto-escalate to oncall if no response in N hours

sam: We should codify risk via heuristics (percent change > X, affects > Y customers, changes routing logic) so console can pick approver set.

leo: Storage/cost: full snapshots every change -> archive quickly. Keep latest N snapshots in DB for quick diffing, TTL older ones to glacier/archive. Eventstore should hold metadata only.
leo: Also consider storing a compact explainability blob (markdown) with links to snapshot; renders fast in UI.

deploy-bot: change_event chg-1716123456-42 created by ben — staged rollout: cohort A=5% -> start 2026-03-12T14:00Z

aisha: small detail: make the API ergonomic for programmatic workflows: PATCH /runtime-configs/:id?dry_run=true&explain=true and return {preview, impact_summary, required_approvals}

ben: agree on API. Also we should surface telemetry gates: prevent rollout past stage N if metric regressions > threshold.

marta: Security: signature + immutable hash in eventstore is necessary for audits. We can also include optional human rationale templating (severity, expected regressions, mitigation plan) to standardize reviews.

sam: We need a backfill migration plan: existing flags -> create snapshot for last-change, compute diffs for history, mark migrated.

marta: Next step — I'll draft a short PR with schema options (snapshot-only / diff-only / hybrid) + a minimal UI wireframe for 1-line "why" + expand. Want volunteers for review: @ben @aisha @sam @leo

ben: +1 :thumbsup:

aisha: happy to help on UX and the dry-run evaluator integration

leo: can take storage/archival concerns

marta: Great — I'll post the draft tomorrow and ping y'all. If you have strong opinions about "no snapshots ever" vs "snapshots always", DM me before I lock the options.
